keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Ethan Williams (Peterborough United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Daniel Kyerewaa (Reading) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Peterborough United 0, Reading 1. Daniel Kyerewaa (Reading) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Andy Rinomhota.
Goal! Peterborough United 0, Reading 2. Jack Marriott (Reading) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Haydon Roberts with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Udoka Godwin-Malife (Reading).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Peterborough United 0, Reading 3. Charlie Savage (Reading) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jack Marriott.
First Half ends, Peterborough United 0, Reading 3.
Substitution, Reading. Ashqar Ahmed replaces Udoka Godwin-Malife.
Substitution, Peterborough United. Vernon Masara replaces Ethan Williams.
Substitution, Peterborough United. James Dornelly replaces Lucca Mendonça.
Substitution, Peterborough United. Liam Kelly replaces Harry Ashfield.
Second Half begins Peterborough United 0, Reading 3.
Harley Mills (Peterborough United) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Peterborough United. Danny Ormerod replaces Matthew Garbett.
Substitution, Reading. Jamie Reid replaces Jack Marriott.
Substitution, Reading. Randell Williams replaces Kyreece Lisbie.
Ashqar Ahmed (Reading) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Peterborough United. Josh Feeney replaces Sam Hughes.
Brandon Khela (Peterborough United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Peterborough United 0, Reading 4. Jamie Reid (Reading) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Paudie O'Connor following a set piece situation.
Goal! Peterborough United 0, Reading 5. Jamie Reid (Reading) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Liam Fraser.
Substitution, Reading. Conor Masterson replaces Josh Knight.
Substitution, Reading. Emmanuel Osho replaces Daniel Kyerewaa.
Liam Kelly (Peterborough United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
